facts.fact: Ansel 与 Johnny 骑车去小木屋——享受风与引擎；父亲虽被他 loathed，却在进 Folsom 终身监禁前给他种下摩托情结
facts.anchor: before he’d headed to Folsom Prison for a life sentence

facts.fact: 他从没去探过父亲；宁可 go out in a blaze 也不愿被关笼子
facts.anchor: He’d rather go out in a blaze than be locked in a cage

facts.fact: 两处细节：不带手机（怕被监听）——他已疑心有人在听
facts.anchor: Neither of them had brought their phones

facts.fact: 命令：现在出发把 Kaylee 带来
facts.anchor: “I need you to leave now and get Kaylee.”

facts.fact: 他的推理：联邦若知道她在哪、她又说了什么，他们早把她带走了——所以她只是跑了，那就还有机会「让她讲道理」
facts.anchor: that gives us a chance to make her see reason

facts.fact: Johnny 提议直接一枪爆头
facts.anchor: Or I can just put a bullet in her head

facts.fact: 他掐住 Johnny 的脖子：谁做决定？——Johnny 挤出「你，老板」；他再收紧一次警告后松手，Johnny 跪地喘气
facts.anchor: Who makes the decisions around here?

facts.fact: 他要的是 bring her to me——先谈话，别做不可逆的事
